---
description: "Add a designer credit to the website footer with small handwriting style"
argument-hint: "Designer name (e.g., Arjun)"
---

Modify the website's footer to include a designer credit in small handwriting style.

1. Update the HTML in index.html to add the text "website designed by {designer}" in the footer element.
2. Update the CSS in style.css to style this text with small font-size (e.g., 0.8rem) and cursive font-family (e.g., 'cursive' or 'Brush Script MT').

Ensure the styling is consistent with the site's design.
